name: lfwin-payment-mcp
description: Payment MCP server for AI agents. Create cashier payment orders, display QR-code fields, query by platform order_no/orderid, create refund requests, and query actual refund status.

tools.name: create_payment_order
tools.description: Create a cashier payment order. merchant_order_no is the merchant mch_orderid for business correlation. Display pay_qrcode_markdown in Markdown clients, the image content block when supported, pay_qrcode_image as an img src/data URL, pay_qrcode_base64 with pay_qrcode_mime_type, or pay_url/qrcode as fallback. Save order_no when present. If order_no is null, save merchant_order_no plus order_time for query_payment_order polling.

tools.name: query_payment_order
tools.description: Query payment status. Prefer platform order_no/orderid returned by create_payment_order. If order_no is null, pass merchant_order_no plus order_time returned by create_payment_order.

tools.name: refund_payment_order
tools.description: Create a refund request by platform order_no/orderid. Use a unique mch_refund_no for each refund attempt or partial refund. status 4001 or 10000 means accepted or processing, not refund success; call query_refund_status next.

tools.name: query_refund_status
tools.description: Query actual refund status by platform order_no/orderid, and pass the same mch_refund_no when available. status=4001 is processing; status=10000 plus refund_status=1 is success; status=10000 plus refund_status=2 is failed.
